offline_validation.guard_scope: Job-local wrapper patches the actual installed registry instance only during the one-shot. It allows only two absolute reads, a create-only exact output path, and one exact foreground test command with a fixed workdir and 120-second timeout. It rejects outside paths, traversal, symlinks, unexpected tools/arguments, repeats, and stale output. A violation latches HALT; if marker persistence fails, an in-process latch still blocks later calls.
offline_validation.filesystem_note: Hermes write_file denies the assigned /usr/tmp path as a protected system path. The one authorized write is therefore implemented by the local wrapper using a descriptor walk with O_NOFOLLOW and O_EXCL; reads and the terminal test delegate to the installed registry. No Hermes global code was modified.

credential_incident.details: Two embedded legacy OpenRouter credential literals were printed by an earlier bounded source inspection. Their values and hashes are intentionally absent from this receipt.
credential_incident.remediation: Both embedded fallback constants were removed from active OpenRouter and deepseek-flash scripts. Active lookup now uses inherited environment credentials only and fails closed. The current inherited route credential was compared in memory and was distinct from the exposed literals.
credential_incident.owner_action: No automatic revocation or global key shutdown was performed. Owner should revoke either exposed credential if it remains valid.
credential_incident.backup_rollback_rule: Do not restore embedded credential literals from backup, even during rollback.

private_backup.coverage: Pre-migration Hermes config, environment/auth credential files, existing local OpenRouter key file, active skill scripts, tests and docs. The backup directory is private and ignored; no backup contents or credential hashes are reproduced here.

account_snapshot.source: Read-only OpenRouter key metadata endpoint; fields filtered before display.
account_snapshot.qualification: The usage endpoint can update asynchronously and the delta may include other account activity; it is not attributed solely to this worker. No credits or subscriptions were added.

roll_back.procedure: Use the private backup only to restore routing/config/docs if needed. Keep the existing fallback order without duplicating the restored primary, preserve environment-only credential lookup, and never restore embedded exposed credential literals.
roll_back.halt: Do not remove or clear the failed-run HALT marker automatically. A fresh model worker needs an explicit root-approved run scope, fresh output path, and the guarded job driver.
